description: Header file defining functions and includes for creating and managing device models, endpoints, resources, and metadata in a device SDK.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device object with specified UUID, class, version, driver name, and descriptor.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadata
methods.description: Creates device metadata associated with a device, identified by metadataId and value.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a device endpoint with specified ID, profile, and enabled status.

methods.name: createDeviceResource
methods.description: Creates a device resource with specified parameters including resource ID, value, type, mode, and caching policy.

methods.name: createDeviceResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates a device resource if available, with initial resource values.

methods.name: createEndpointResource
methods.description: Creates a resource for a given endpoint with specified parameters.

methods.name: createEndpointResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates an endpoint resource if available, with initial resource values.

methods.name: createEndpointMetadata
methods.description: Creates metadata for an endpoint with specified ID and value.
